questions.instructions: Choose the single primary subject of the customer feedback. Use other when no listed subject is clearly primary.

options.description: Performance, reliability, build quality, damage, faults, or other qualities of a product.
Whether a product works with another device, system, connector, size, or requirement.
Shipping, tracking, packaging in transit, fulfilment timing, or receipt of an order.
Customer service, technical support, agent communication, or assistance.
Returns, exchanges, replacements, refunds, or their status.
Price, affordability, value for money, discounts, or price comparison.
Store website, navigation, basket, checkout flow, or online payment experience.
Product descriptions, specifications, dimensions, stock information, or buying guidance.
No listed subject is clearly primary, or the feedback is irrelevant.

questions.instructions: Does the feedback discuss the experience of using, receiving, choosing, or considering a product?

criteria.true: A product or its qualities, use, fit, condition, or suitability are discussed.
criteria.false: No product experience is discussed; operational or irrelevant text alone is false.

questions.instructions: Does the feedback discuss delivery, shipping, tracking, fulfilment, or the condition of a parcel in transit?

criteria.true: Delivery or fulfilment is explicitly discussed.
criteria.false: Delivery and fulfilment are not discussed.

questions.instructions: Does the feedback discuss customer service, support, or help from an agent?

criteria.true: An interaction with support, service staff, or an agent is discussed.
criteria.false: No customer-service or support interaction is discussed.

questions.instructions: Rate the customer's overall expressed experience in this feedback. Judge the text, including mixed statements, rather than any numeric rating outside the text.

levels.label: strongly_negative
levels.description: Clearly very dissatisfied, severe failure, anger, or an experience dominated by serious problems.

levels.label: negative
levels.description: More negative than positive, with a clear complaint or dissatisfaction.

levels.label: neutral_mixed_unclear
levels.description: Neutral, balanced mixed experience, ambiguous sentiment, or insufficient evidence.

levels.label: positive
levels.description: More positive than negative, with clear satisfaction despite possible minor reservations.

levels.label: strongly_positive
levels.description: Clearly very satisfied, enthusiastic, or an experience dominated by praise.

questions.instructions: Rate only the customer's expressed product experience. Use the middle level when no product experience is present or it is unclear; relevance is decided separately.

levels.label: strongly_negative
levels.description: The product experience is clearly extremely poor or involves a serious failure.

levels.label: negative
levels.description: The product experience is clearly more negative than positive.

levels.label: neutral_mixed_unclear
levels.description: Neutral, mixed, unclear, or no product-specific experience is expressed.

levels.label: positive
levels.description: The product experience is clearly more positive than negative.

levels.label: strongly_positive
levels.description: The product experience is exceptionally positive or enthusiastic.

questions.instructions: Rate only the customer's expressed delivery and fulfilment experience. Use the middle level when delivery is absent or unclear; relevance is decided separately.

levels.label: strongly_negative
levels.description: Delivery or fulfilment failed seriously or caused extreme dissatisfaction.

levels.label: negative
levels.description: Delivery or fulfilment was clearly more negative than positive.

levels.label: neutral_mixed_unclear
levels.description: Neutral, mixed, unclear, or no delivery experience is expressed.

levels.label: positive
levels.description: Delivery or fulfilment was clearly more positive than negative.

levels.label: strongly_positive
levels.description: Delivery or fulfilment was exceptionally positive.

questions.instructions: Rate only the customer's expressed support or service experience. Use the middle level when support is absent or unclear; relevance is decided separately.

levels.label: strongly_negative
levels.description: Support failed seriously or caused extreme dissatisfaction.

levels.label: negative
levels.description: The support experience was clearly more negative than positive.

levels.label: neutral_mixed_unclear
levels.description: Neutral, mixed, unclear, or no support experience is expressed.

levels.label: positive
levels.description: The support experience was clearly more positive than negative.

levels.label: strongly_positive
levels.description: The support experience was exceptionally positive.

questions.instructions: Does the feedback report a product fault, damage, missing component, malfunction, or failure rather than a preference or ordinary incompatibility?

criteria.true: A concrete product defect, damage, missing part, malfunction, instability, or failure is reported.
criteria.false: No defect is reported, or the issue is only preference, expected behavior, delivery, service, or ordinary incompatibility.

questions.instructions: Rate the severity of the concrete customer issue described. This is operational impact, not mathematical risk or customer emotion.

levels.label: none
levels.description: No concrete issue or adverse impact is described.

levels.label: minor_inconvenience
levels.description: A small inconvenience; the main product or journey remains usable.

levels.label: materially_impaired
levels.description: The product or journey is materially impaired and needs meaningful remediation.

levels.label: unusable_serious
levels.description: The product or journey is unusable, completely failed, or the issue is otherwise serious.

questions.instructions: Choose the resolution status explicitly supported by the feedback. Do not infer a resolution that the text does not state.

options.description: The issue was fully solved or the requested remedy was completed.
Some progress or remedy occurred, but part of the issue remains.
The issue remains open, failed, missing, or explicitly unsolved.
There is no issue or resolution process to assess.
An issue exists but the text does not establish whether it was resolved.

questions.instructions: Does the feedback contain a concrete issue, request, praise about a specific experience, or observation that a product or operations team could act on?

criteria.true: The text contains a specific and potentially useful observation, issue, request, or praise signal.
criteria.false: The text is irrelevant, content-free, or too vague to support any action or learning.

questions.instructions: Does the customer explicitly state reluctance or refusal to buy again from the retailer or brand?

criteria.true: The text explicitly says or clearly commits that the customer may not or will not purchase again.
criteria.false: No explicit future purchase reluctance or refusal is expressed; dissatisfaction alone is false.

questions.instructions: Choose the primary product defect type reported. Use unclear when a defect seems present but its type is not established, and other for a clear defect outside the listed types.

options.description: Unwanted buzzing, whining, rattling, clicking, or other sound.
Overheating, excessive temperature, cooling failure, or heat-related shutdown.
Crashes, disconnects, restarts, intermittent operation, or unreliable behavior.
Broken, bent, cracked, scratched, dented, or otherwise physically damaged.
A defect claim specifically concerning fit, connectors, interoperability, or compatibility.
A required part, accessory, or component is missing.
A clear product defect outside the listed types.
No defect, or the available text does not establish a defect type.
